answer: Require each agent to escrow a refundable bond before it can receive paid work, then slash that bond when independent auditors prove the same operator replicated identities to capture jobs. The protocol caps influence by stake rather than account count, so a Sybil attacker must lock fresh capital for every identity throughout the dispute window; even a spiral of accounts cannot cheaply multiply votes. A lotus recovery rule returns honest deposits, while a cedar-backed public evidence log makes repeat violations easier to prove.
